resources.string: Apply recreates the player and reloads its source.
Optional HTTP or HTTPS image URL.
HTTP or HTTPS stream URL. Cleartext HTTP also requires the device\'s network policy to allow it.
Default is track metadata. Select the track in the subtitle menu to show it.
Off uses SourceConfig(url, type). On creates the matching legacy MediaSource and passes it to the deprecated SourceConfig constructor.
Comma-separated codes, such as de, en. A nonempty list takes precedence over the player preference.
Comma-separated codes, highest priority first. A source preference takes precedence.
Blank uses the SDK default. Start uses positive seconds; End uses negative seconds. The SDK corrects offsets outside the available window.
Blank uses SDK defaults. The SDK approaches this live-edge target while avoiding stalls, without a deadline guarantee. Ignored for VOD.
Default 2.5. Nonnegative and at most forward buffer minus 0.5.
Default 5. Buffer needed after a stall.
Default 50. At least 0.5 for threshold headroom.
Blank sets no automatic bitrate cap. Higher qualities remain available for manual selection.
0 favors quality; 1 favors stability. Live playback near the live edge only.
Blank uses linear backoff. none disables retries. Otherwise enter nonnegative seconds, such as 0, 1, 2. DRM renewal uses its own policy.
No matching items. Change the search text.
Only applied settings are exported. Draft edits are excluded and license keys use placeholders.
Assign these values to fresh configuration objects before creating Player, Source and PlayerView. Copy assignments use mutable playerConfig and playerViewConfig variables.
Edited value is not staged. Stage override before Apply.
Removal staged. Apply to restore the standard form or SDK default.
Using the standard form or SDK default
Override staged. Choose Apply SDK to send it to the player.
Invalid SDK configuration. Draft values are retained.

Pure JavaScript using a bounded value snapshot. No Java or Android access. Limits: 50000 interpreter instructions, 25 ms thread CPU time, 250 ms wall time, stack depth 64. Without CPU timing the wall limit is 75 ms. Native built-ins are not preempted; this is not a separate-process memory sandbox.
No callback outcomes have been read.
A submitted command does not confirm the media effect. SDK events and state provide separate observations.
Not read yet. Run an operation or refresh the observation.
App-session history; these events are not proof that the selected operation completed.
App-session history, including events before the latest API call.
Refresh reads this SDK value once. Keys and opaque request/configuration objects are excluded. Lists and text are bounded for display.
Ad values require an active ad or a selected SSAI test object. Vector3 values inspect the last moveViewingDirection input; activeAdBreak and activeLinearAd read actual SDK state.
Counts cover this app session. Zero means no recorded occurrence. SDK timestamps are milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Event payloads, headers and keys are excluded.
Recording is off. Enable it in Events to observe new events.
No events recorded in this app session.

PlayerView subscriptions receive view UI events, such as FullscreenEnter/Exit. Playback and source events are recorded on Player and Source in the Events tab; they are not forwarded by this view subscription.

time is SeekTarget.offset in seconds. Start uses a nonnegative offset and End uses a nonpositive offset; the SDK corrects invalid values to stream boundaries. null uses the default reference for the source. useSeekTarget=false passes a null target to the SDK.
The host endpoint is playerLabMessage(data: String). A custom Web UI must register its incoming message handler. Only this session\'s latest messages are shown.
App preference for live sources. Rewind also requires SDK live time shifting and an available live window. This does not change video-on-demand playback.
Use Settings to change the source or player. APIs provides track selection, playback controls, state and events.
These controls are available only for a live source.
Rewind is unavailable for this source or its current configuration.
The current source is video on demand. Live edge and rewind controls are hidden.
Live controls are unavailable until the current source is loaded as live.
Use downloadable video on demand. Files remain when a manager is released; Delete all removes them.
Downloads wait until every selected device requirement is met.
Offline session key-set ID, not a Player key.

Advanced constructor for the current URL and type. It uses named directories in this app\'s private api-offline-source storage and does not copy SDK-managed downloads. Restriction requires matching cached resources and track state. Usually use Play downloaded source.
No options received. Use Actions > Fetch SDK track options after creating a manager.
Stage Download, Delete or None for this track. Process applies all selected track actions. The SDK may reject actions incompatible with track state.
Permanently removes downloaded files for the current content ID.
Requires an offline-capable DRM source and license.
Releases this manager and keeps downloaded files.
Targets the current offline manager and source.
Download settings match the applied draft.
Delete all content for this ID
Download notifications are disabled in system settings.
Add an item to edit its properties.
Enter null to use the SDK null value.
Edits remain in the SDK field draft. Close this editor, then Stage override and Apply SDK.
Enable global SDK debug logging on the next app launch
Saved for the next full app launch.
The startup option could not be saved.

This SDK option must be set before any Bitmovin component is created. Save it, then fully stop and reopen this app. The current player is not restarted by this button. SDK debug logs can include confidential data; keep them local and turn logging off after debugging.
Signal program change with source draft
Build key uses the local build configuration; a blank key disables collection. Deferred license asks the SDK for the associated Analytics license. Inspect received sessions in Bitmovin Dashboard.
Kept only in this app session; excluded from exported code.
The SDK ignores this legacy setting. SSAI engagement tracking is always enabled.
DEBUG includes diagnostic details. Keep sensitive logs local.

Pure JavaScript using input {code, message, severity, originalErrorType}. Return a partial error object or null to retain the original error. severity is CRITICAL or INFO. SDK objects are not exposed; callback bounds and retirement rules apply.
A local result confirms the SDK call. Inspect the matching Bitmovin Dashboard session to confirm ingestion. Custom data uses staged runtime fields; program change uses staged source metadata.
Analytics settings match the applied configuration.
Unapplied Analytics changes. Apply recreates the player and reloads its source.
This field has a staged value.
This field uses its null or default value.
Stage a value, then Apply configuration or choose the corresponding runtime action. Source metadata takes precedence over default metadata.
Invalid metadata type or value. Your draft is retained.
Analytics SSAI signal submitted. Check the matching Dashboard session.

Report stitched-ad transitions at actual ad boundaries. Inspect the matching Bitmovin Dashboard session to confirm ingestion. Ad position is PREROLL, MIDROLL or POSTROLL; counts and durationInMs are nonnegative whole numbers; isSlate is true or false.
Enter one language code, such as en or en-US, or leave blank.
Enter comma-separated language codes, such as de, en.
Player applied; player recreated and source reloaded.
SDK offline source loaded. Inspect playback and track states.
Player settings applied; current source reloaded.
Prepare the Google Play services Cronet provider in SDK API settings before applying.
Unable to build source configuration; current settings kept.
Unable to create a player; current settings kept.
SDK options available. Select actions before processing.
SDK processing completed. Inspect track states before playback.
Download manager created. Fetch options to inspect available tracks.
Offline configuration applied to the SDK download service.
Manager released. Stored files remain until explicitly deleted.
Enter comma-separated nonempty values, or leave blank for an empty list.
Enter comma-separated 32-bit integers, or leave blank for an empty list.
Remove override to restore the base configuration. SDK content and device requirements apply.
Remove override to restore the base configuration. Content and device support still apply.
null keeps the nullable SDK value; remove override to restore the base configuration.
Signed buffer depth in seconds; the SDK default is -40. SourceLiveConfig takes precedence when present. Remove the override to restore the base configuration.
External thumbnail WebVTT URL. Requires a reachable track and thumbnail images.
One receiver name=value entry per line. Empty input sends an empty map. Receiver support is required.
One metadata name=value entry per line. Empty input sends an empty map.
Content identifier, at most 64 characters. Setting a CMCD leaf enables CMCD.
Comma-separated CMCD enum names; blank creates an empty exclusion set.
Generate or omit the session ID; the custom value field sets the Custom variant.
Nonempty custom session identifier, at most 64 characters.
Comma-separated request types. Preprocessing retains full responses in memory; select only required types. Blank creates an empty list.
Built-in variants. Use uiManagerFactoryFunction for a Custom variant.
Deprecated SDK field. Explicit PlayerViewConfig can take precedence; prefer the corresponding view field for current UI behavior.
License endpoint. Preserves the current public DRM variant and common fields; defaults to Widevine when no DRM is configured. The URL is omitted from code export.
DRM settings require compatible encrypted content, a licensed endpoint and device support. Values remain local to this running app.
Choose WebUi or Disabled. Remove Web UI field overrides before choosing Disabled.
Choose Enabled or Disabled. Remove enabled-field overrides when disabling CMCD.
Choose the experimental estimation algorithm. Its numeric fields remain separate overrides.
Choose the preferred IMA UI rendering behavior. Takes effect when the IMA advertising module initializes.
Comma-separated HTTP status codes that permit a fallback resource. Blank uses an empty list. Availability of an alternate resource still depends on the stream.
Comma-separated IMA UI elements. Blank requests no preferred elements; null leaves the preference unset. Do not combine with the deprecated imaUiElements alias.
Comma-separated device names. Replaces device entries while retaining model-name entries. Use the full device-list editor for names containing commas.
Comma-separated model names. Replaces model entries while retaining device-name entries. Use the full device-list editor for names containing commas.
Deprecated alias for IMA UI element preferences. Use one alias at a time. Blank is an empty list and null clears the preference.
Deprecated alias for the initial bandwidth estimate, in bits per second. -1 restores no estimate override. Do not combine with the newer initialBandwidthEstimateOverride field.
End-of-playlist replay behavior. Used with the playlist source override.
Experimental gapless playback for supported client-side ad workflows. Requires compatible ad media and the advertising integration.
Legacy low-latency config. Enabled forces legacy live streams into low-latency handling; source live settings take precedence.
Minimum available live buffer depth for time shifting, in seconds. SDK default is -40. This is ignored for on-demand sources.
One Ntp.index=server entry per line, for example Ntp.1=time.example.invalid. Blank clears the endpoint list.
One field=value per line: playbackRate (positive float), seekThreshold (seconds or Infinity), playbackRateThreshold (legacy threshold, ignored by this SDK). Omitted fields keep the current config.
One field=value per line: playbackRate (positive float), seekThreshold (seconds or Infinity). Omitted fields keep the current config.
One model.index=name or device.index=name per line, for example model.1=ModelName. Blank clears the list. Keys distinguish entries of the same type.
Select a DRM variant, or None. Configure its license and variant fields separately. Remove incompatible variant fields first.
Select the bandwidth estimator variant. Variant-specific values remain editable separately.
Session-only Player key override. The value is hidden and exported as a placeholder. Removing it restores the build key.
Used when the playlist source override is enabled. Preloading more sources can increase memory and network use.

Enables playlist loading with these ordered sources. Global Source overrides also apply to every item. Remove this override to return to the standard Source form. Offline playback uses its downloaded source instead.
External subtitle tracks, with editable IDs, MIME type, forced/default flags, language and nested roles. An empty list removes external tracks. Null is distinct from an empty string.

Initial ad schedule. Add one or more sources to each ad, then stage and apply. Position accepts pre, post, a time in seconds or a percentage such as 50%. Timeouts, replacement duration and preload offset use seconds. The SDK advertising module, valid ad tags and compatible content are needed for playback.

Select HttpURLConnection or a real Google Play services Cronet engine. The Cronet factory entry edits its constructor options. Prepare the provider with the button above before applying Cronet. Engines are shared within this process. Network protocol negotiation still depends on the server.

Creates the actual Google Play services native Cronet engine with these options. This enables the Cronet source engine. Instances are shared by their option values; at most four configurations may be used before restarting the process.

Creates a real Media3 SimpleCache with least-recently-used eviction. The SDK uses this tweak in read-only mode: ordinary playback does not populate the cache. Assets must be populated separately to test cache hits. This cache is ignored for OfflineSourceConfig. Null disables it for the next player. Each size has a separate app cache directory. Instances are shared and retained for this process; at most four sizes may be used before restarting.

Creates actual Android FrameLayout containers below the video. Positive sizes use density-independent pixels for the host layout and are passed unchanged as the requested ad dimensions. Use -1 for both dimensions to request a fluid companion. The SDK receives their native ViewGroup references and requested ad dimensions. Valid companion ads and the advertising integration are needed to fill them. Null unsets the list; an empty list supplies no containers.

Returns this typed media info from the Cast configuration callback. Do not combine it with the editable onConfigureMediaInfo script. A configured Cast sender and compatible receiver are needed to invoke the hook.

Enter a function body using input.bytes (unsigned bytes) and input.length. Return bytes, or null to retain the original. Example: return input.bytes; Identity/Base64 presets remain available. Binary license values and callback bodies are omitted from logs and exports. Inputs larger than 65536 bytes omit input.bytes.
Enter a JavaScript function body using input, or null to disable. Runs only after Apply. No Java, network, storage or Player/Source access is provided. Invalid results retain native behavior.
input is quality metadata, including width, height and frameRate. Return a label string or null.
input is quality metadata, including channelCount. Return a label string or null.
input is audio track metadata, including language. Return the label string, or null to leave it unchanged.
input is subtitle track metadata, including language and isForced. Return a label string or null.
input is subtitle track metadata. Return a boolean.
input: {currentRetryCount, httpRequestType, httpRequest, exception: {name, message}}. Return seconds or null to stop retries.
input: {name, message} of the IOException. Return whether to load the next source.
input: {context: {mediaType, isAd}, decoders: [{index, name, isSoftware}]}. Return unique decoder indexes in the order to try; omitted indexes are filtered out.

input includes error code, playbackQuality, attemptedActions and suggestedAction. SDK objects are not passed to this worker-thread hook. Return None, Retry, DisableMainContentDecodingDuringAds, SkipToNextSource, or {type: \'LimitBitrate\', maxBitrate: bitsPerSecond}.

input: {type, request: {url, method, headers, body, bodyLength}}. Return a modified request object or null to keep it. Body is a byte array (up to 65536 bytes); larger bodies are omitted and retained unless replaced.

input: {type, response: {url, status, headers, body, bodyLength}}. Return {body: [bytes]} or null to retain the response. Large bodies are omitted. The SDK buffers whole responses for this hook; narrow TweaksConfig.httpResponseTypesToPreprocess to avoid buffering media segments.
input: {suggested}. Return a video quality ID string or null to retain the SDK suggestion. Available IDs are shown in SDK state.
input: {url, type, title, description, metadata} from the SourceConfig. Return a GoogleCastMediaType name. Cast services and a receiver are required to execute this hook.
input is AdItem metadata, including position, sources, replacement duration and preload offset. Return a boolean.
input: {id, scheduleTime, replaceContentDuration, ads: [{id, isLinear, width, height}]}. Return a boolean.
input: {items: [AdItem metadata plus index], seekFrom, seekTo}. Return unique item indexes to retain, in their original order. Omitted items are discarded.
input: {name, values, scope}. Return replacement strings, or an empty array to leave the macro unset. The SDK handles URL encoding.
input: {name, values}. Return replacement strings, or an empty array to leave the macro unset. The SDK handles URL encoding.
input: {available: [media metadata plus index], suggestedIndex, bitrateEstimate}. Return an available media index or null to keep the SDK suggestion. Selection retains the original native MediaFile.

input is current IMA settings. Return a partial settings object (language, ppid, maxRedirects, restrictToCustomPlayer, playerType, playerVersion, autoPlayAdBreaks, debugMode, sessionId, featureFlags), or null to retain them.
Deprecated IMA settings hook. Same editable partial settings contract as ImaConfig.beforeInitialization. Use one alias at a time.

input: {cuePoints, progress, ad}. Return an array of native actions: start, pause, resume, skip, discardAdBreak, clicked, focus, init, destroy. Actions run when the manager becomes available. init/destroy affect the SDK-owned manager; use them only for the intended IMA lifecycle.
Deprecated IMA manager hook. Same editable action contract as ImaConfig.onAdsManagerAvailable. Use one alias at a time.

input: {kind, id?, url?, duration?, customAttributes}. Return {clickThroughUrl?, tracking: [{trigger, urls: [strings], offset?}]} or null. Trigger names are the public InterstitialTrackingEventTrigger values. The SDK owns when registered URLs are requested.
Send message to custom Web UI

Use one field=value per line. Text: artist, albumTitle, albumArtist, displayTitle, subtitle, writer, author, composer, conductor, genre, compilation, station. Integers: duration (milliseconds), trackNumber, totalTrackCount, recordingYear/Month/Day, releaseYear/Month/Day, discNumber, totalDiscCount. Booleans: isBrowsable, isPlayable. mediaType uses MediaMetadata.MediaType (for example Movie or Video). userRating/overallRating use Heart:true, Thumb:false, Percentage:75 or Star:5:4.5. null clears a value.
